name: security-audit-skill
description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
one_liner: A ready-made playbook that turns any AI coding assistant into a structured security auditor, hunting for vulnerabilities in a codebase and double-checking its own findings before reporting them.
buyer: A security consultancy, or a CTO at a startup without a dedicated security team, who wants a rigorous first-pass vulnerability audit before (or instead of) an expensive manual pentest.
business_use_cases: A security consultancy runs it as an automated intake triage before assigning a human pentester, cutting billable hours per engagement.
A SaaS company with no security team runs it monthly as a continuous, cheap audit layer between annual professional pentests.
A bug-bounty hunter uses its multi-phase methodology to systematize and speed up their own hunting process on new programs.

money_ideas.idea: Offer flat-fee 'AI-assisted security audit' reports as a productized service
Sell a monthly continuous-audit subscription to SaaS companies between real pentests

steal_this: Run it this weekend against a few open-source projects, publish the (responsibly disclosed) findings as a case study, and use that as proof for a paid 'AI security audit' offer.
